tools.name: verify_numbers
tools.description: Verify that the numbers in a finished table add up — before you deliver it. Use this when you have produced or received a table, spreadsheet, CSV/TSV or markdown table, a cost breakdown, invoice, quotation or budget, and need an independent check that row totals, column totals and subtotals are arit

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_numbers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
